priorityQueue.whyItMatters: Vendor-payment evidence remains the largest missing spend-chain node.
priorityQueue.nextEvidenceNeeded: Obtain a lawful record-level payment source with accounting period, payee roles and privacy safeguards.

priorityQueue.whyItMatters: Municipal award identifiers could connect approvals to retained tender entries.
priorityQueue.nextEvidenceNeeded: Find an eligible official award record carrying exact contract or tender identifiers.

priorityQueue.whyItMatters: Council decisions can establish actual approvals instead of assumed budget authority.
priorityQueue.nextEvidenceNeeded: Select a documented council decision with a specific motion and project or contract identifier.

priorityQueue.whyItMatters: Health institutional actuals can contextualize publicly reported service costs.
priorityQueue.nextEvidenceNeeded: Select an official financial statement and establish entity consolidation and reporting year.

priorityQueue.whyItMatters: Separate IWK accounts avoid conflating hospital institutions and directive scope.
priorityQueue.nextEvidenceNeeded: Keep IWK financial statements distinct from other health institutions and account for cash versus accrued amounts.

priorityQueue.whyItMatters: Water utility capital approvals, contracts and actual costs could form a tractable municipal service chain.
priorityQueue.nextEvidenceNeeded: Trace an identified utility capital project through official decisions, contract records and reported costs.

priorityQueue.whyItMatters: Accountability reports can connect authorized programs to reported delivery.
priorityQueue.nextEvidenceNeeded: Match a program’s documented commitments to its reported delivery using exact identifiers.

priorityQueue.whyItMatters: Tender notices may clarify identifiers and procurement stage missing from award field.
priorityQueue.nextEvidenceNeeded: Clarify the procurement stage and identifiers of a selected official tender notice.

limitations: A source reference, a source URL, an evidence artifact and an application collection are different things. This page does not add a new evidence-collection count.
Broad indexes and publisher homepages remain research references even when separate documents from those publishers have been reviewed.
Publication fields refer only to retained named deployment checkpoints, not current refresh health or a guarantee that the latest site version is unchanged.
Historical data and source-specific accounting limits remain attached to their evidence collections. Source acceptance does not make every field public or establish unrestricted reuse rights.
Same-URL reference rows are not counted as separate data sources. SI049 and SI121 have inconsistent inventory geography descriptions requiring source-metadata verification.
No source was contacted while preparing this coverage page. An unverified state is not proof that no records exist.
rightsScope: Factual source identifiers, original-source URLs and independently written coverage descriptions; no source documents, private logs or personal data reproduced.
